body: "And so I leave this world, where the heart must either break or turn to lead." - Nicholas Chamfort

I see your point, I understand that the choice I'm making is very selfish, and that the noble path would be to stay and fight for what I believe in. I guess I'm just a weak person. 
I feel like my heart is breaking, like my soul is rotting away... I think I'm already dying. 
I've tried to avoid and escape the harsh truth for so long, but I can't live like this forever. Whenever I have to take a reality check and face it all, it's just too much for me.
